title: NEtherlands Longitudinal Lifecourse Study 2022 - Versie 1.0
descriptions: Codebook and data of the NEtherlands Longitudinal Lifecourse Study 2022. A cross-sectional study on a sample of 3017 inhabitants of the Netherlands, age group 15-45, with oversamples of the Moroccan and Turkish minorities. The data were collected in the period of June - September 2022 through a web survey.The variables include family background indicators, socio-demographic and socio-economic background variables, social inequality, social cohesion and integration, a large set of values, norms and attitudes, and egocentric network items.
